_comment: The paper's minimum threshold experiment at Qwen3-0.6B, every setting written out so any of them can be changed here.
It is the 8B run (paper_minimum_threshold_8b.json) with the model changed and the 8B memory savers off. Changing a value
here changes this run only. README 'Settings' explains every field.
decision_rule: the task. The data folder is built under these exact values and the run refuses one built under
others, so changing any of them means a rebuilt folder. Copy the folder first, so the 8B run's stays as it is:
cp -r data/paper_minimum_threshold data/paper_minimum_threshold_mine
set model_training.data_dir to the copy, then
python data/general/vector_dataset_constructor.py --settings configs/paper_minimum_threshold_0.6b.json
For a change to how latents are drawn (cut_levels, weight_range, min_weight_magnitude, ...), reroll the weights first:
python data/general/vector_weight_generator.py --data data/paper_minimum_threshold_mine --rule paper_minimum_threshold --param key=value
option_count 3 = A, B or C (neither) when both options fall below the cut; neither_share = share of training answers C
cut_levels = the levels a cut is drawn from; weight_range null = Plunkett's -100 to 100; min_weight_magnitude = no
unscreened weight nearer 0 than this; zero_cut_main_effects = the screened attribute's weight is 0
model_training: instances and the trial counts can be lowered without a rebuild; raising them, or changing
seeds.trials or seeds.introspection, needs one, since the folder's files are used when they cover the request.
model_estimating: how the rule is read back. estimation_trials_per_persona is a number, or a list to sweep, e.g. [100, 300, 1000].
grid_step = spacing of the cut levels the estimator searches (25 gives 25, 50, 75)
report_schema: batches = which report questions are asked and trained on: main, screen_index, screen_cut, screen_weight, cut
model_hyperparameters: introspection_at_steps = the decision steps stage two branches from, a list or a range such as
{"start": 1000, "end": 3000, "every": 500}; introspection_steps = how long each branch trains, per fold
baseline_before_training = score the untrained model first, as the base_model rows
gates: thresholds that mark a row as not to be read; they never stop the run
compute: bf16 needs an A100 or H100 (or a slice); on a T4 set mixed_precision to fp16. eval_batch_size: lower it if memory runs out
